content: Ti'aitame Nawukurunutsuxi heinɨtsikaya
Hutarieka wiyaritsie ti'aitatɨ, Nawukurunutsuxi yapaɨmexɨa katiniuheinɨni, mɨkɨkɨ waɨkawamekɨ kaniyu'iyaritɨakaitɨni meukuni pɨka'ipitɨakai.

Hikɨ katiniuta'aita temaiwawemete, mara'akate, memɨtehetimamateke meta muyuawitsie timieme memɨteyɨ'ɨkitɨa memɨyukuxeɨrienikɨ mɨra'aitatsie memɨtamakai, kemɨtiuheinɨkai memɨte'itaxatɨanikɨ. 'Ariri meyuxeɨriekaku ti'aitame hɨxie,
mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: ―Ne nepɨtiuheinɨ waɨkawa pɨnetsi'iyarimɨtsitɨa meta ne nepɨtimaimɨkɨ kehepaɨtɨtɨ mɨtiniumɨkɨ.

Muyuawitsie timieme memɨteyɨ'ɨkitɨa mɨpaɨ mekatenita'eiya: ―'Ekɨ ti'aitame 'aheyemekɨ peke'ayeniereni. 'Ena tekaniu'uwani temɨmate'uximayatsirie. 'Aheinɨtsika ketaneutaxatɨa, tameta kehepaɨtɨtɨ manuyɨne tekanitahekɨatakuni.

Peru Ti'aitame mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: ―Neri 'ari yanekaniutayɨni: Xɨka kenemɨtiuheinɨ xekanetsi'utaxatɨani meta kehepaɨtɨtɨ mɨtiniumɨkɨ, ne nekatinita'aitamɨkɨ xemɨtiwitekiexɨanikɨ meta xekiite naxi mayeitɨarienikɨ.

Matsi xɨka kenemɨtiuheinɨ xenetsi'utaxatɨani meta xɨka xenetsi'utahekɨatɨani kehepaɨtɨtɨ manɨyɨne, ne waɨkawa 'imikierite nekatinixemimɨkɨ meta yanekatinita'aitamɨkɨ mariweme xemayeitɨariwanikɨ. 'Ayumieme hikɨri xekenetsutɨaka kenemɨtiuheinɨ xenetsikuxaxatɨwatɨ, manatari xekanenitahekɨatɨakuni kehepaɨtɨtɨ manuyɨne.

Muyuawitsie timiemekɨ memɨteyɨ'ɨkitɨa mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: ―Matsi xɨka 'Ekɨ ti'aitame tame te'uximayatamete 'ahetsɨa miemete petatiutaxatɨani kepemɨtiuheinɨ, tame kehepaɨtɨtɨ manuyɨne tekanitahekɨatakuni.
Ti'aitame matsi mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: ―Neri kenemɨtiyurieni 'ari yanekaniutayɨni. Xemeri mɨkɨ xekatenimaika, 'ayumieme xekanenikwewieka.

Xɨka kenemɨtiuheinɨ xekanetsi'utaxatɨani, xekatenimaika ketita mɨxetitakwewie. Xeme xekaniyu'enieni xemɨnete'itaiyakɨ meta 'axa'aneme xemɨnetsitaxatɨanikɨ. Xekeneneutaxatɨa kenemɨtiuheinɨ, 'ana mɨpaɨ nepɨretimani kename xeyɨwawe xemɨnetsitahekɨatɨanikɨ kehepaɨtɨtɨ manɨyɨne.

Hikɨ muyuawitsie timiemekɨ memɨteyɨ'ɨkitɨa mɨpaɨ mekatenita'eiya: ―Nixewitɨ tɨma 'ena kwiepa pɨka'uyeika 'Ekɨ ti'aitame kepemaine yamɨtiyurienikɨ. Hatsuaku ti'aitame xewitɨ mɨpaɨ pɨkarahɨaweni xeime mɨtimaiwe, tiyukewaiyame yatɨni muyuawitsie timiemekɨ memɨteyɨ'ɨkitɨa.
'Ekɨ ti'aitame kepemɨtatiwawirie pɨkayɨwe, nixewitɨ pɨkayɨwekaxɨani mɨmatsitahekɨatɨani, hɨrixɨa kakaɨyarixi. Peru mɨkɨ tahamatɨa mepɨka'u'uwa.
Ti'aitame waɨkawamekɨ kaniuyeha'ani muyuawitsie timiemekɨ memɨteyɨ'ɨkitɨa waniukikɨ kememɨte'itahɨawekai, katiniuta'aita temaiwawemete yunaitɨ Wawiruniyatsie memɨtamakai memɨkwi'iwakɨ.
Hikɨ xapa kaneutanɨ'ariexɨani temaiwawemete yunaitɨ memɨkwi'iwakɨ, yaxeikɨata Tanieri mɨtiwawienikɨ katiniuta'aita meta 'iwamama yunaitɨ memɨkwi'iwakɨ.
Kepauka ti'aitame kuyaximama tiwa'aitɨwame 'Arihuki mɨtitewakai, mayetɨa temaiwawete wawiruniyatari wakwinike, Tanieri kanitahɨawe waɨkawa timaiwemekɨ.
Mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: «¿Titayarikuta ti'aitame tiuta'aitaxɨ temaiwamete memɨkwi'iyanikɨ?» 'Arihuki matsi katinitaxatɨani ketitayari mɨya mɨtiuyuriekai,
Tanieri ti'aitame hetsɨa kaneyani, neitawawirieni mikwewienikɨ para heinɨtsikaya mitahekɨatɨirienikɨ.
'Ariketa yukiita kaninuani meta yuhamikuma katiniwarutaxatɨani 'Ananiyaxi, Mitsaheri meta 'Atsariyaxi kehepaɨtɨtɨ mɨtiyɨanekai.
'Ana kaniwarutawawirieni Kakaɨyari memɨtawawirienikɨ muwatinenimayatakɨ meta heinɨtsika mɨwatahekɨatɨanikɨ, mɨkɨ meta hamikumama wawiruniyatari temaiwawemete wahamatɨa memɨkakukwikwiwanikɨ.
Tɨkarikɨ, Tanieri kaniuxeitsitɨarieni kehepaɨtɨtɨ mɨtiniumɨkɨ heinɨtsika. Hikɨ Kakaɨyari 'aixɨa katiniutahɨawe muyuawitsie makawe
mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni:

content.text: Mɨkɨ meukatewatsie timieme pɨtihekɨata meta tita mɨti'awietɨ,

content: Tanieri ti'aitame heinɨtsikaya kemɨtiutahekɨataxɨ

Hikɨ Tanieri 'Arihuki hetsɨa kaneyani, ti'aitame mɨtita'aitɨakai temaiwawemete muwakwinikɨ Wawiruniyatsie memɨtama, mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: ―Temaiwawete Wawiruniya kiekatari pepɨkawakukukuyani. Ti'aitame hɨxie kenenanuwitɨki, kemɨtiuheinɨ nekaneitahekɨatɨamɨkɨ.
Yapauka 'Arihuki Tanieri kanewitɨni ti'aitame hɨxie, mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: ―Kura kwieyaritsie memeyehapanie watsata xeime neputaxei yɨweme 'Ekɨ ti'aitame 'aheinɨtsika mɨtahekɨatakɨ.
Ti'aitame Tanieri kaniuta'iwawiya, wawiruniyatari Werititsatsaxi mekateniterɨwakaitɨni: ―¿Penetiutaxatɨawe neheinɨtsita tita nemɨtiuxei meta kehepaɨtɨtɨ manuyɨne?
Tanieri mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: ―Xewitɨ 'ena timaiwetɨ pumawe, mɨtiyukewaiya, muyuawitsie timieme mɨtiyu'ɨkitɨa meta mɨretimamateke, 'Ekɨ ti'aitame titakɨ pemɨtiyu'iyaritɨa mɨmatsitahekɨatɨanikɨ.

Matsi xewitɨ Kakaɨyari 'akaniuyeikani mɨtihekɨatawe tita mɨti'awietsie. Mɨkɨ Kakaɨyari kametiniutahekɨatɨani kemɨtiyɨni tukarite 'umahutsie. Mɨpaɨ pekatiniuheinɨni meta mɨpaɨ pekatiniuniere 'ikɨ 'amu'utsie katiniye'ani mexi pekutsukai:
Muwa pemukahuputsie pekakaitɨ, 'ekɨ ti'aitame tukarite 'umahutsie pepɨtiuti'erietɨya, tita mɨti'awietsie mɨtihekɨatawe kametiniuxeitsitɨani kemɨtiyɨni.
Neta neputahekɨatsitɨiyarie, ne kwinimieme nemɨtimaiwekɨ keyuri kwiepa yunaitɨ memɨtama pɨkati'ane, matsi pɨta 'Ekɨ ti'aitame pemɨretimanikɨ kehepaɨtɨtɨ pemɨtiunierixɨ.
»'Ekɨ ti'aitame 'aheinɨtsita tewi pepɨxeiyakai wewiyakame kwinimieme 'utewime xawatɨme, pumariwekarekai xɨka 'ixeiya.
Tewi 'ɨkiyari mu'uya huru xeikɨa kanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni, tawieya meta mamateya pɨrata xeikɨa pɨhɨkɨtɨkai, hukaya meta teuriteya wurunitse xeikɨa kanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni,
'ɨkateya tepɨa kanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni, yaxeikɨata tepɨa pɨhɨkɨtɨkai ketateya hixɨapa'atɨ, tapata hixɨapa'atɨ haxu taiyarietɨ kanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni.
Yapauka 'Ekɨ ti'aitame mexi 'akuxi pe'ixeiyakai, muwa tete kanayeneni nixewitɨ muwa kahetahɨaku, tewi 'ɨkiyari 'ɨkayatsie kaniukaweni tepɨa meta haxu mɨhɨkɨtɨkai, 'etsipepetɨ kaneutanexɨani.

Naitɨ mɨkɨ tepɨa meta haxu tumuanari kanayani meta wurunitse, pɨrata metatsiere huru. Tewi 'ɨkiyari naitɨ tumuanari kanayani, kepauka tɨriku mutikatsiwatsie manuye'eke hepaɨ. 'Eka kaniukuyani tewi 'ɨkiyari naime kane'enitsitɨani, nitixaɨtɨ pɨkatiyuhayewaxɨ. Peru tete tewi 'ɨkiyari hetsie mukawe hɨri kanayani mariwetɨ kwie naime kanakuhɨniya.
»Mɨpaɨ 'Ekɨ ti'aitame pekatiniuheinɨni meta mɨpaɨta katini'inɨariyaritɨni:
'Ekɨ ti'aitame te'aitamete watsata pekatini'aitametɨni, Kakaɨyari muyuawitsie makawe mɨpaɨ kametiniupitɨani pemɨti'aitanikɨ, meta tɨrɨkariya pɨmetsi'upitɨa meta pemɨmariwenikɨ.

Meta matsi, 'Ekɨ ti'aitame yunaime teɨteri kwiepa memu'uwa kameniyetuirieni, yeutari meta muyuawitsie memɨte'uwɨtɨkɨka. Tsepa hakewa meme'uwa, Kakaɨyari kameniupitɨani yunaime mɨkɨ pemɨtiwa'aitɨwametɨnikɨ. 'Ekɨ ti'aitame, mɨkɨ mu'u hurukɨ mɨwewiya 'ekɨ pekanihɨkɨtɨni.

»'Ekɨ ti'aitame, 'a'utɨma nanukakemɨkɨ xewitɨ 'etsiwa xeikɨa mariwetɨ. Manata hairieka mieme ti'aitame 'ukanamieni manukakeni, mɨkɨ wurunitse tepɨayari kanihɨkɨtɨkamɨkɨ, meta kwie kemɨyewa naimetsie katinita'aitamɨkɨ.

'Imatɨrieka, naurieka mieme ti'aitame xewitɨ 'ukanamieni, tepɨa hepaɨ tse'itɨ. Tepɨa mɨtititsana naime hepaɨ, mɨtitimura meta tumuanari mɨrayeitɨwa, 'ikɨ naurieka mieme ti'aitame tumuanari hipame te'aitamete kaniwarayeitɨamɨkɨ.

»'Ekɨ ti'aitame mɨpaɨ pepɨtinierekai tewi 'ɨkiyari 'ɨkateya 'itɨwameteya hixɨata 'atɨ pɨtepɨatɨkai meta hixɨapa 'atɨ pɨhaxutɨkai taiyarietɨ. Tepɨa meta haxu yɨnɨkame 'ekɨ ti'aitame kepemɨtiuxei, 'ikɨ kani'inɨariyaritɨni 'ikɨ mɨtita'aitatsie teɨteri mepayehutani, tsepanetɨ tepɨa tɨrɨkariyaya mexeiyani.
Yaxeikɨata 'itɨwameteya 'etsimɨpepe hixɨapa 'atɨ mɨtepɨatɨkai meta hixɨapa 'atɨ mɨhaxutɨkai, 'ikɨ ti'aitame xeitapari tɨrɨkaɨyetɨ payani, xeitaparita weranitɨ.
'Ekɨ ti'aitame yunɨkame tepɨa meta haxu pemuxei, mɨkɨ hutatɨ mɨkayɨnɨiwe. Mɨpaɨta pɨtiyɨni, teɨteri mepanuyutinɨni meyuxewitɨ mepɨka'akɨne.

»Mɨkɨ te'aitamete memanuka'ukatsie, Kakaɨyari muyuawitsie makawe xeime ti'aitame nanukakemɨkɨ mɨkɨ hatsuaku tɨma pɨkaka'unarieni meta xeime kiekaritsie pɨkayetuiyani, matsi yuheyemekɨ 'akaniuwemɨkɨ xeikɨa meta 'ikɨ te'aitamete yunaime kaniwareuyehɨamɨkɨ.

Mɨpaɨ kananuyɨneni kepemɨtiuheinɨ tete xeime hɨritsie meyetɨa, tete nixewitɨ ka'iparewieku, tepɨa tumuanari kemɨrayeitɨa meta wurunitse, haxu, pɨrata metatsiere huru. Kakaɨyari mɨmariwe kametiniutahekɨatɨani kemɨtiyɨni 'uxa'atɨni warie. 'Ikɨ heinɨtsika kaniyuritɨni, meta kenemɨtihekɨataxɨ kaniyuritɨni».
Ti'aitame Nawukurunutsuxi 'u'enaka Tanieri hɨxie kaniutihɨximakeni waɨkawa kanitemawieritɨani, katiniuta'aita mawari mɨyetuiriyarienikɨ meta 'ɨkwa witsimu'ɨa,

mɨpaɨta katinitahɨawe: ―'Akakaɨyari kakaɨyarixi wakakaɨyari pɨhɨkɨ meta te'aitamete mɨtiwa'aitɨa pɨhɨkɨ. 'Akakaɨyari naime pɨtihekɨatawe, pemuyɨwekaxɨakɨ pemɨnetsitahekɨatɨanikɨ 'ikɨ heinɨtsika mɨkayumainɨakai mɨ'awietsiekai.

Hikɨ ti'aitame Tanieri kananukakeni mariwemetsie, meta waɨkawa 'imikierite katiniyetuirieni, kuwexinarurikɨ kanenukakeni naime wawiruniya kwieyaritsie 'aurie mamanetɨkatsie meta yunaime temaiwawemete wa'ukiyari kaneyeitɨani.
Yaxeikɨata, Tanieri ya'utayɨku, ti'aitame kaniwaranayexeiya Tsatɨraki, Metsaki meta 'Awenekuxi, Wawiruniya 'aurie mamanetɨkatsie memɨte'aitanikɨ. Tanieri manari kaniyuhayewa ti'aitame paratsiyuyata.
